review.render_prompt: Use the supplied B3000 manufacturer diagram as structural reference. Create one beautiful photorealistic interior concept of a single B3000 cabinet at nominal 36-inch width, 34-inch height and 24-inch depth. Exactly ONE full-width upper drawer in ONE horizontal row above exactly TWO equal lower hinged doors, one concealed adjustable shelf. All drawer and doors CLOSED, unlike the open reference. Illustrative natural oak finish, recessed black plinth, thin white countertop, subtle dark pulls. Three-quarter architectural photograph, full cabinet in frame, minimal plaster room, soft window daylight, stone floor. No extra cabinets, stacked drawers, open shelves, sink, text, logos or watermark. Preserve the confirmed structure; this is a concept, not certified installed geometry.
